tasks.title: Conversation #5
tasks.transcript:
MEN: Hello, Ms. Maxwell. You wanted me to visit to talk about something?
WOMAN: That's correct. I need to talk about the tenants upstairs in the unit
above me. They keep making too much noise late at night.
MEN: I see. Have you spoken with them in person to request that they be quieter?
WOMAN: I have, but that didn't work. They still listen to music and play the guitar at all hours of the day and night.
MEN: Okay, I'd better pay a visit to 4C and have a talk with them. When I'm done, I'll come back down here.
WOMAN: Thanks. I really appreciate your assistance.

questions.stem: What does the woman mean when she says, “That didn't work”?

options.A: Her neighbors did not become quieter.
options.B: Her kitchen sink did not stop leaking.
options.C: She could not get her rent reduced.
options.D: She was unable to repair a broken window.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士说“That didn't work”时的含义，属于语义理解题，需结合上下文判断“that”指代的内容以及“didn't work”的具体结果。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士前面说曾当面与楼上邻居沟通，要求他们安静一些。随后说“but that didn't work”，并接着说“They still listen to music and play the guitar at all hours”，说明邻居并没有变得安静，沟通没有起到作用。 选项B：错误。 对话中完全没有提到厨房水槽漏水的问题，属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项C：错误。 对话讨论的是噪音问题，从未提及租金减免，属于凭空捏造。 选项D：错误。 对话中未出现窗户破损或维修的内容，与女士所说的话毫无关联。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do next?
questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士接下来最可能做什么，属于推理判断题，需根据对话末尾男士的话推断其下一步行动。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士明确说“I'd better pay a visit to 4C and have a talk with them”，4C是楼上的单元（女士住在楼下，楼上单元在4C）。随后又说“When I'm done, I'll come back down here”，说明他要先上楼去。 选项B：错误。 对话中提到楼上邻居听音乐和弹吉他，但男士是去解决问题，不是去听音乐，属于无关干扰。 选项C：错误。 男士决定亲自上门谈话，没有提到要打电话，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 对话完全没有提到女士的厨房，更不用说检查厨房了，属于与原文无关的干扰项。
